query: DELETE FROM mailbox_deliveries WHERE rowid IN (SELECT delivery.rowid FROM mailbox_deliveries AS delivery WHERE delivery.created_at_ms < ? AND delivery.delivery_status IN ('accepted','failed','discarded') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wakeup_definitions AS wake WHERE wake.pending_delivery_id=delivery.delivery_id) ORDER BY delivery.created_at_ms,delivery.delivery_id LIMIT ?)
